name: arxiv-export
description: Export a Markdown academic paper into an arXiv-ready LaTeX submission package

plugins.name: arxiv-export
plugins.description: Turns a Markdown academic paper (e.g. from academic-paper / writing-editorial) into an arXiv-recompilable LaTeX source package plus a local PDF proof. Treats the common 'bare-unicode math with no $ delimiters' case as a first-class scenario: per-block agents delimit math and convert unicode→LaTeX with a mandatory spot-check loop, then structure into amsthm theorem environments, build the bibliography, verify the compile (tectonic/XeLaTeX or pdfLaTeX), and package for arXiv.
